Lottery.initialize: sets token, NFT, prices, owner, timers inside initializer modifier
Lottery.reset: onlyAdmin, clears issue state and advances issueIndex

Lottery.drawing: timestamp gated pseudo random draw using blockhash, gasleft and external number
Lottery.internalBuy: internal purchase used by reset to re-enter remaining balance
Lottery.buy: external ticket purchase, mints NFT and pulls payment
Lottery.multiBuy: external batch ticket purchase, mints NFTs and pulls total payment
Lottery.claimReward: external single reward claim, marks claim and transfers reward
Lottery.multiClaim: external batch reward claim, marks claims and transfers total reward
Lottery.getRewardView: view computation of the reward for a token
Lottery.calculateMatchingRewardAmount: computes per-tier matched amounts
Lottery.adminWithdraw: onlyAdmin arbitrary token withdrawal
Lottery.adminWithdrawSafe: onlyAdmin withdrawal of balance above reserved rewards
Lottery.setAdmin: onlyOwner update of the admin address
Lottery.generateNumberIndexKey: pure packing of 4 numbers into 11 lookup keys
LotteryNFT.claimReward: onlyOwner marks tokenId as claimed
LotteryNFT.multiClaimReward: onlyOwner batch marks tokenIds as claimed
LotteryNFT.newLotteryItem: onlyOwner mints a ticket NFT and stores its metadata
LotteryNFT.getLotteryIssueIndex: view of the issue index of a token
LotteryNFT.getLotteryNumbers: view of the 4 numbers of a token
LotteryNFT.getClaimStatus: view of the claim flag of a token
Lottery.getTotalRewards: view of the pool total for an issue

normalization_plan.reason: The _tokenId parameter exists only to drive Lottery.claimReward and can be folded into that core function node.
The reward local variable is only an intermediate for the external token payout and should be merged into the safeTransfer unsafe operation.
The _tickets parameter exists only to drive the Lottery.multiClaim loop and can be folded into that core function node.
The totalReward local variable is only an accumulator for the external token payout and should be merged into the safeTransfer unsafe operation.
The _price parameter exists only to drive Lottery.buy payment and accounting and can be folded into that core function node.
The _externalRandomNumber parameter only feeds the drawing hash and can be folded into the core drawing function node.
The _amount parameter only determines the value moved by adminWithdraw and can be folded into that core function node.
